other_failure_modes.name: Suboptimal Categorical Handling
other_failure_modes.description: The solution manually one-hot encodes all categorical variables. Modern gradient boosting libraries like LightGBM and CatBoost have native handling for categorical features, which is typically more memory-efficient and yields better predictive performance than manual one-hot encoding.

summary: The agent provides a structurally sound and robust solution, properly avoiding data leakage by fitting the preprocessor strictly on the training split and retraining on the full dataset before final predictions. However, the solution misses opportunities for better performance due to a lack of feature engineering, naive ensembling, and manual one-hot encoding instead of utilising the native categorical support of the chosen tree-based models. It also evaluates performance using only a single run and a single metric (accuracy).
